mr.mod.national_glory.name: Project National Glory
mr.mod.national_glory.desc: Joint amphibious assault doctrine, mobilized reserves, and cross-strait offensive planning for a military return to the Mainland.
mr.mod.strait_armada.name: Cross-Strait Sealift Armada
mr.mod.strait_armada.desc: Expanded naval slipways, fast landing flotillas, and forward maritime logistics across the strait.
mr.mod.mainland_underground.name: Mainland Civic Underground
mr.mod.mainland_underground.desc: Clandestine radio broadcasts, coastal cells, and republican defector networks awaiting the liberation landing.
mr.mod.return_momentum.name: Return to the Mainland
mr.mod.return_momentum.desc: A secured mainland bridgehead has ignited an unstoppable liberation offensive, drawing volunteers and defectors to the banner.
mr.mod.regime_shock.name: Mainland Bridgehead Shock
mr.mod.regime_shock.desc: Enemy amphibious forces have broken onto the coastal heartland, rattling regime morale and sparking unrest across the provinces.
mr.dec.national_glory.name: Revive Project National Glory
mr.dec.national_glory.desc: Reorient the armed forces from static island defence to cross-strait amphibious reclamation, mobilizing reserves and offensive strike doctrine.
mr.dec.national_glory.unavail: Requires Taiwan with at least 45% stability.
mr.dec.strait_armada.name: Expand Cross-Strait Sealift Armada
mr.dec.strait_armada.desc: Commission fast landing craft, amphibious escorts, and port logistics to carry successive divisions across the Taiwan Strait.
mr.dec.strait_armada.unavail: Requires Taiwan with at least 40% stability.
mr.dec.mainland_underground.name: Activate Mainland Underground
mr.dec.mainland_underground.desc: Fund covert civic networks and sympathetic officers in Fujian, Guangdong, and Jiangnan to rally behind a landing force.
mr.dec.mainland_underground.unavail: Requires Taiwan with at least 40% stability.
mr.ev.glory_council.title: The Mainland Return Council
mr.ev.glory_council.desc: Senior planners in Taipei present a bold blueprint reviving the historic dream of returning to the Mainland: an amphibious spearhead across the strait timed to a crisis in Beijing.
mr.ev.glory_council.con1: Mobilizes trained reserves, raises offensive doctrine, and prepares the strait crossing.
mr.ev.glory_council.opt2: Focus on the fleet and sealift first
mr.ev.glory_council.con2: Strengthens naval readiness and shipbuilding while keeping the home front calm.
mr.ev.strait_window.title: Across the Strait: The Hour Has Come
mr.ev.strait_window.desc: With war raging across East Asia, radio stations in Taipei broadcast directly to Fujian, Guangdong, and Nanjing calling on citizens and garrisons to welcome the returning republic.
mr.ev.strait_window.opt1: Throw everything into the Mainland offensive
mr.ev.strait_window.con1: Mobilizes volunteers and surges offensive momentum across the front.
mr.ev.strait_window.opt2: Coordinate coastal cells and fleet resupply
mr.ev.strait_window.con2: Refills fleet stores and deepens mainland underground support.
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.title: Restlessness Along the Southern Coast
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.desc: Wartime strain and broadcasts from across the Taiwan Strait are stirring quiet defiance in coastal cities across Fujian and Guangdong.
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.con1: Keeps the treasury intact, but deepens stability loss and regional radicalism.
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.opt2: Dispatch emergency subsidies to coastal provinces
mr.ev.coastal_ferment.con2: Spends treasury and dampens war enthusiasm to calm the cities.
